The issuer shows materially weak credit fundamentals: negative shareholders’ equity (-8,465M), large accumulated deficits (retained earnings of -8,881M), liabilities exceeding assets, and sub-1.0 liquidity (current ratio 0.92), all of which indicate balance-sheet stress. While positive EBIT of 777M on 9,532M revenue provides some operating support, the overall profile remains highly vulnerable and best fits a low speculative-grade rating.

DECISION: CCC+
